name: Biased pennies
description: A zero-sum 2x2 matrix game with a lopsided payoff. Its unique equilibrium has both players show heads with probability 1/3; the row player's value is 1/3.

brief.situation: The row player (A) and the column player (B) show a coin at the same time.
brief.rules: Both heads: A wins 3. Both tails: A wins 1. Different sides: B wins 1. What one wins the other loses. A player who shows nothing takes their worst result: A loses 1, B loses 3 (nothing if neither shows).

do: $a.score = 0 if $a.side == '' and $b.side == '' else -1 if $a.side == '' else 3 if $b.side == '' else $world.payoff[$a.side][$b.side]

do.say: A showed {$shown_a or 'nothing'}; B showed {$shown_b or 'nothing'}.
